label: late-episode D1 dip in z, deepest after reaching S2 (esp. via a1 rare)
terms: (phase == D1) * np.clip(ep_trial - 89, 0, 10)**2 ;; (phase == D1) * np.clip(ep_trial - 89, 0, 10)**2 * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * np.clip(ep_trial - 89, 0, 10)**2 * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * np.clip(ep_trial - 89, 0, 10)**2 * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * np.clip(ep_trial - 89, 0, 10)**2 * belief ;; (phase == GO) * np.clip(ep_trial - 89, 0, 10)**2 * belief
explanation: Update gate z of unit 24 sits near 1 (keep state) almost always; variance is concentrated in the last ~10 trials of the episode, mainly at D1, where z dips (to ~0.5-0.9). Beyond the per-decile timing baseline, the dip grows roughly quadratically over trials 90-99 and is gated by the previous trial: much deeper when the previous trial reached S2 (largest weight), partly offset if S2 was reached by a2 (common), so a1->S2 (rare) gives the deepest dips; previous S2 rewarded deepens it a bit more; higher ideal-observer belief that S1 is good slightly deepens D1 and GO dips. Outside late episode and at GO/D2 the effects are tiny. Trial-before history, stay streaks and belief_cover add nothing. Test R^2 beyond timing 0.43 (3-term ramp x prev_state/prev_action version 0.41), well above the profile all ceiling 0.13 because the profile cues lack the within-decile ramp interaction. Residual within-late-episode variance (dips differ across episodes with similar recent history) remains unexplained; no model outputs used, and the earlier value/policy-based account is not needed for this level of fit.
